content.short: Blur is an NFT marketplace and aggregator.
content.description: Blur, launched October 19, 2022, is an NFT marketplace and aggregator that enables users to compare NFT listings from multiple marketplaces, monitor their holdings with advanced analytics, and complete purchases directly through the platform. Backed by venture capital, the service emphasizes faster sweep and sniping actions relative to competing platforms and is described as ten times faster than the Gem aggregator. It combines marketplace comparisons, portfolio analytics, and on-platform NFT purchases into a single interface for easier trading.
